subject: SET statement
notes: SR22's condition is met only when identifier-7 references a RESTRICTED program-pointer, which is the one asymmetry with SR20 (every function-pointer is restricted; a program-pointer may or may not be). Landing it needed the DECLARATION, which was staged loud with COBOL0899 until this change set: PicInfo.RestrictedPrototypeName now carries the TO operand for BOTH prototype carriers and 13.18.60.3 SR19's TYPEDEF requirement is enforced beside its SR18 twin. Both failure directions are pinned: a differently-signed prototype AND an UNRESTRICTED sender, which is a violation in its own right rather than a vacuous pass - SR22 requires prototypes 'associated with identifier-7 and identifier-8' and an unrestricted program-pointer is associated with none (14.8.2.3.2 says the same thing explicitly in the argument-passing direction). A prototype that names no COMPILE-TIME signature - 12.3.8.4 GR10 c), the external repository - deliberately conforms, because rejecting it would refuse a legal separately-compiled target.
